verdict.rationale: Elicit's own docs describe a dedicated Systematic Reviews workflow. It covers title/abstract screening, a separate automated full-text screening step and column-based data extraction across papers, and the API offers control over screening criteria and extraction parameters. Community accuracy complaints concern summaries and search, not the screening or extraction workflow, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of screening/extraction accuracy at scale, and explicit UI-level documentation of how screening criteria are defined and applied consistently across all papers.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria

citations.quote: The Systematic Reviews workflow provides step-by-step guidance through search, screening, and data extraction, culminating in a research report summarizing the relevant papers.
Elicit supports the major steps of a systematic review: 1. Set up your review on the Setup page 2. Gather all papers for the systematic review 3. Screen papers by title and abstract
Full-Text Screening is a distinct, automated step in the Systematic Review workflow that catches these mismatches before you commit to data extraction.
Create a column for each data point you'd like to extract from your papers.
Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.
